sections.Profile:
The Junk Yard pinball machine, released by Williams in 1996, was designed by Barry Oursler and Dwight Sullivan. In this game, players take on the role of an inventor trapped in a junkyard, with the objective of escaping by collecting junk to build various machines. Key features include a wrecking ball crane, a toilet that flushes the ball, and a doghouse with an attack dog, all of which contribute to the machine's engaging and playful theme.
